item.title: Gov. Beshear Orders Flags Lowered for National Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day
item.description: Governor Andy Beshear has ordered flags at all state office buildings to be flown at half-staff from sunrise to sunset on Sunday, December 7, in honor of National Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day. National Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day

item.description: Ronald Dwight Adams, 81, of Crofton, Kentucky died at 8:22 a.m., Friday, December 5, 2025, at his home in Crofton, Kentucky. Funeral services will be held at 2:00 p.m., Monday, December 8, 2025, at Kelly Baptist Church
